title: Tesla Is Lightyears Ahead Of... Tesla
summary: SuperfastMatt looks at how the Tesla Model S retracting door handles were redesigned over time, from many parts to a motor plus sensor, with a focus on engineering and reliability.
why: Recommended whenever door handles or car reliability engineering come up, as an enjoyable look at design iteration.

quote.text: This is a great video by SuperfastMatt on the engineering behind and evolution of the Tesla door handle.
